t: Russian Foreign Minister Arrives in Bahrain
d: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov has arrived in Bahrain, where on Sunday he will take part in the ninth round of the strategic dialogue between Russia and the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), a Sputnik correspondent has reported.

t: Ukraine Caused Nearly $13 Billion in Damage to Russian Regions - Investigators
d: The Russian Investigative Committee has estimated the damage inflicted by Ukraine on Donbass and the border and rear regions of Russia at almost $13 billion, Investigative Committee Chairman Alexander Bastrykin told Sputnik on Sunday.

t: Iran’s New Defense Chief Warns US Will Pay Heavily for Another Attack
d: The US will not dare to attack Iran, otherwise it will suffer huge damage, the new defense minister of Iran, Mehrdad Akhlaghi, said on Sunday.

t: Russian Diesel Supplies Beneficial to US Consumers - US Energy Secretary
d: Diesel fuel supplies from Russia could benefit consumers in the United States, US Energy Secretary Chris Wright said on Sunday.
